The combat system has quite a bit of a learning curve, and it really does depend on a deeper level of skill beyond typical precision or timing kinds of skill that you see in most games. The first real combat lesson I got made me feel like a kid picking up a sword for the first time, but then like a student. It seems like it will take a lot of time and practice to master. The save system adds to the experience, and it makes me play much more cautiously, where I don't want to risk my life from crossing an enemy I haven't learned how to properly fight, or even risk falling or getting caught committing a crime.
